definitions.full: H2829. Cheshmon חֶשְׁמוֺן proper name, of a location town in southern Judah , site unknown Josh 15:27 . טַלְמֹן , once טַלְמוֺן proper name, masculine name of porters . 1 1Chr 9:17 ; Ezra 2:42 = Neh 7:45 . 2 Neh 11:19 ; 12:25 ( טַלְמוֺן ).
